field_description: For a calendar deadline belonging to this goal whose date genuinely needs clarification, copy the complete applicable deadline wording VERBATIM from goal.source_quote. The quote must preserve the complete goal meaning, including consecutive sentences needed to identify words such as 'that quarter', with all relevant speakers, conditions and qualifications. null when the source does not support this deadline for this goal, when that linkage is missing, conflicting or ambiguous, when the date is already known, or when the words instead describe a launch reference, runway, forecast horizon, learning or measurement window without being this goal's deadline. Do not turn a calendar point into a guessed month count. This is Olumi's source-linked interpretation for a clarification only; it does not verify human goal ownership, set or save a date, approve a change or permit a Run.
claim_question: Olumi reads "<deadline words>" as a calendar deadline for "<goal name>". Which date does that mean? The model does not yet hold a confirmed date for this reading. Retained wording: "<complete verified goal.source_quote>"
